items.title: Top 5 Densest Planets (#1 Is the One You're Standing On) #shorts
items.description:
A litre of each planet on a kitchen scale. Number one weighs 5.51 kg, and Saturn would float.
Full video: How Long to Reach Every Planet? By Car, Neptune Takes 4,912 Years

Sources
• NASA planetary fact sheets (NSSDC): mean density Earth 5,514, Mercury 5,429, Venus 5,243, Mars 3,934, Neptune 1,638, Jupiter 1,326, Uranus 1,270, Saturn 687 kg/m³
• 1,000 kg/m³ = 1 kg per litre (density of water)
• NASA Science, Mercury: its metallic core takes up about 85% of the planet's radius

Visuals are original. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
#shorts #space #planets #solarsystem

items.title: That Dot Is Our Sun. 343 Million of Them Fit Inside Betelgeuse #shorts
items.description:
Betelgeuse is about 700 times wider than the Sun. 700 × 700 × 700 = 343 million Suns by volume, and you can see it tonight in Orion.
Full video: What If We Swapped the Sun for 5 Other Stars? One Puts Earth INSIDE It

Sources
• NSF NOIRLab / Gemini North release noirlab2523 (July 2025): Betelgeuse has a radius about 700 times the Sun's
• NASA Sun Fact Sheet (NSSDC): mean radius 695,700 km, volume 1,412,000 × 10^12 km³; NASA Earth Fact Sheet: volume 1.08321 × 10^12 km³
• Own calculations: 700 × 700 × 700 = 343 million Suns by volume; × 1.3 million Earths per Sun ≈ 447 trillion Earths; 700 Sun radii ≈ 3.26 times the Earth–Sun distance
• NASA: the main asteroid belt lies roughly 2.2 to 3.2 times the Earth–Sun distance from the Sun

Visuals are original. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
#shorts #space #betelgeuse #stars

items.title: Shrink the Sun to a Grain of Sand. The Next Star Is 29 km Away #shorts
items.description:
Make the Sun 1 mm wide. Earth becomes a 9-micron speck 10.8 cm away, Voyager 1 sits at 18.6 m, and the next star is 29 km away.
Full video: Voyager 1 Is Now 1 Light-Day Away. A Message Takes 24 Hours

Sources
• NASA Sun Fact Sheet (NSSDC): mean radius 695,700 km (diameter 1,391,400 km, scaled to 1 mm)
• NASA: Earth diameter 12,742 km; Earth–Sun distance 149.6 million km; Neptune about 30.07 times the Earth–Sun distance
• NASA/JPL: Voyager 1 reached one light-day (about 173 times the Earth–Sun distance) in November 2026; launched 1977
• NASA: Proxima Centauri about 4.2 light-years away; the Milky Way's disk about 100,000 light-years across
• Own calculations: 1 mm = 1,391,400 km, so Earth 0.009 mm at 10.8 cm, Neptune 3.2 m, Voyager 1 18.6 m, Proxima 28.9 km, Milky Way 680,000 km (1.8 × the 384,400 km Earth–Moon distance)

Visuals are original. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
#shorts #space #scalemodel #universe
